skill.name: douyin-product-research
skill.description: Search Douyin products through SocialDataX using a category or keyword and optional filters. Review selected listings and record why they match and what needs verification.
skill.summary: Build a Douyin product shortlist with source references and verification notes.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The skill directs users and agents to run an unpinned npm package that can access SocialDataX credentials in the execution environment. Most alerts match Markdown syntax, documentation, or Chinese text; no evidence of an encoded payload or an attempt to override the audit was found. The shell examples lack safe argument handling guidance, and billing recovery does not specify how to validate links from service responses.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution in an authenticated environment
remediation.suggestion: Replace floating npm versions with a reviewed, integrity-verified release. Require user approval before installation and isolate the process from unrelated secrets.

remediation.issue: Local credential persistence and fallback lookup
remediation.suggestion: Use an operating system credential store or a managed secret. Document credential precedence, remove unnecessary fallback variables, and verify that status output never includes secret values.

remediation.issue: Untrusted values in shell command examples
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords, identifiers, URLs, and pagination tokens as separate arguments without shell interpolation. Use structured MCP calls when available.

remediation.issue: Billing links taken from service errors
remediation.suggestion: Show only the fixed official billing URL. Treat links in service responses as untrusted and let the user complete payment directly.

semantic_findings.title: Shell Examples Lack Safe Argument Handling
semantic_findings.description: The direct CLI examples put user-supplied keywords, product IDs, and URLs inside double-quoted shell placeholders. An agent that substitutes raw values into shell text can execute unintended commands.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples show substitution positions but give no guidance on passing values as separate arguments. The risk depends on how an agent builds the command.

semantic_findings.title: Billing Link Forwarding Lacks a Validation Rule
semantic_findings.description: The balance recovery workflow tells the agent to show an official billing link from the service error before falling back to a fixed URL. Without an explicit validation rule, a misleading response could direct a user to an unofficial payment page.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction names the expected billing URL but does not say how to reject a different destination. No malicious response was observed.

content.value_statement: Douyin search results can be hard to compare when listings show different prices and service terms. Build a shortlist with visible prices, match reasons, and details to verify.
actual_capabilities: Search Douyin products by category or keyword through SocialDataX.
Apply optional price bounds in yuan, sort results, and filter by store or service terms.
Look up a product by its listing ID or URL.
Review one results page by default, shortlist up to five matches, and check details for the two or three most relevant.
Report visible prices, match reasons, source references, observation time, and details that still need verification.
limitations: Live research requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. Business requests can consume account credits.
This workflow does not retrieve product reviews. Video comments are not a substitute.
Search samples and sort order do not establish actual sales, growth, market share, or market size.
Profit estimates require user-provided costs and fees. The skill does not modify Douyin accounts or listings.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Products for a Store
use_cases.description: Find products in a target category and price range. Identify the listings that merit a closer look before sourcing.

use_cases.title: Compare Sample Prices
use_cases.description: Compare visible prices across matching listings and note which variants or discounts explain the differences.

use_cases.title: Check Store and Delivery Terms
use_cases.description: Compare listings against requested store, dispatch, or return requirements. Flag any terms the source does not confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Find Initial Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Douyin listings for insulated lunch bags. Show up to five matches from the first page.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a category but no fixed price or service requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Price and Returns
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Douyin desk lamps from 50 to 120 yuan with seven-day returns. Explain why each listed product matches.
prompt_templates.scenario: You know your price range and one required service term.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Known Listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these three Douyin product links: [links]. Record visible prices, specifications, store names, and missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have product links and need a direct comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Extend a Sample With Fixed Filters
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue my Douyin storage-box search for one more page using the same filters. Compare visible prices across both pages and note missing fields. Do not infer market-wide prices.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a previous search with a valid next-page token and need a larger sample.

output_examples.input: Find Douyin desk lamps from 50 to 120 yuan with seven-day returns.
output: Illustrative result: Two listings matched on the first page.
Listing A: 69 yuan for the base model. Seven-day returns shown. Verify whether the price requires a coupon.
Listing B: 99 yuan for the dimmable model. Seven-day returns shown. Verify whether the adapter is included.
The observed prices describe these two listings only.

output_examples.input: Compare the visible price and dispatch terms for these two Douyin product links.
output: Illustrative result: The first supplied link shows 89 yuan and dispatch within 24 hours.
The second supplied link shows 79 yuan. Dispatch time was not returned.
Verify the second listing's dispatch time before treating it as an alternative.

best_practices: State the category, budget in yuan, and any mandatory service terms.
Start with one page and review the most relevant listings before expanding the search.
Keep each listing's source and observation time, and mark missing details as unverified.
anti_patterns: Treating search rank or a small price sample as a Douyin-wide market measure.
Pasting an API key into chat, logs, or model-visible commands.
Restarting a partial search from page one or retrying repeatedly after a balance error.

faq.question: What do I need to start a search?
faq.answer: Provide a category or keyword. Add a budget or service requirements when they matter.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection uses its existing credentials. Do not share your key in chat.

faq.question: Can I look up a product from its link?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a Douyin product URL or listing ID. A video ID does not identify a product.

faq.question: Can results show the best-selling items on Douyin?
faq.answer: The search offers a sales sort option, but the result order does not establish a platform-wide sales ranking.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Douyin account?
faq.answer: No. Product research is read-only and does not post, like, comment, or edit your account.

faq.question: What happens when SocialDataX credits run out?
faq.answer: The skill stops retrying and keeps available partial results. Check your balance directly in the SocialDataX dashboard before resuming.
